application_review: A continuous linear retraction to every finite-dimensional real submodule is constructed from the proved linear left inverse and finite-dimensional continuity; no complement or projection is supplied as a premise.

Every actual integrated native Lie subalgebra subgroup receives a global singleton chart from the retained actual exponential homeomorphism, on its inherited topology. The coordinate exponential is an actual smooth diffeomorphism, and the original subgroup inclusion is smooth.

A global smooth retraction from the original group onto its actual integrated subalgebra subgroup is constructed using original logarithm, continuous linear projection and restricted original exponential. It is a proved left inverse of inclusion. Original subgroup multiplication and inversion are therefore smooth; a genuine boundaryless Lie group structure is proved on that same subgroup.

The retained actual graph-integrated Lie homomorphism is smooth by its exact original exponential-linear-map-logarithm formula. Applied to the full finite integer-evaluation image, this proves smoothness of every integer evaluation.

The actual all-integer array group receives the composite original exponential global chart. Its identification with the finite image is a diffeomorphism and is proved equal to the retained actual group equivalence in both directions. Actual pointwise multiplication, inversion and every literal integer evaluation are smooth.

Any actual pointwise array subgroup inherits the same lower-central cutoff and nilpotency-class bound as the original group. This applies to the full native exponential arrays, without enlarging the step.

The actual native exponential array group, its constructed finite-dimensional Lie model and its exact all-integer pointwise lattice now instantiate the existing NativeNilmanifoldData interface at the original step. Complete normed model, simple connectedness, discreteness, cocompactness and the compatible quotient metric are constructed from proved results. The group and specified lattice fields are identified literally. Quotient smooth charts are not part of that interface and are not claimed here.

Reviewed smoothness without circular group assumptions: singleton-chart manifold construction uses only the proved homeomorphism. The inclusion and retraction are proved smooth using the original group exponential and logarithm. Subgroup operations are obtained using the original group operations and the retraction left-inverse identity, before installing the new Lie group theorem.

Reviewed finite-product model topology: recursive group topology remains unchanged. The local recursive topology instance has priority 10 in the new array smooth modules so the tangent submodule uses its canonical norm topology, as required by ModelWithCorners. No topology equality is postulated, no existing instance is modified globally, and all structures are kernel typechecked together.

Reviewed array transport: the constructed diffeomorphism equals the existing group equivalence, including its inverse. Pointwise multiplication and inversion are the original subgroup operations. Every integer evaluation is the literal a.val z, not a surrogate function.

Reviewed nilpotency and interface assembly: the cutoff is inherited via actual coordinate group homomorphisms. The assembled NativeNilmanifoldData group field is exactly the all-integer array subgroup and its Gamma field is exactly the pointwise original lattice, with equality theorems. The retained constructor supplies the metric and quotient-map compatibility.

The NativeNilmanifoldData interface contains a smooth ambient Lie group and a compatible metric on its actual compact coset space, not a proof of a smooth quotient atlas or smooth quotient evaluations. Those obligations remain explicit.

All new named declarations are selected for strict Lean elaboration and transitive axiom checking. Full incremental build, retained-source hashes and unchanged prior axiom sets are checked. No independent kernel replay or fresh isolated build is claimed.

StrongConjecture and the original full finite monochromatic sums/products claim remain unproved. Finite-list native periodic interval inverse existence remains an explicit unproved hypothesis; its genuine existence proof and positive uniform correlation constants must be supplied. Conditional Prediction includes actual admissible parameters, positive finite scale-list closure, common native unit observables and complete fixed-ultrafilter calibration and count limits. Conditional Alignment includes the canonical finite-word schedule, actual execution, positive palette-scale budgets, common positive denominator and certified actual auxiliary visits. Integer realization now proves the actual master pair scale relation, exact natural numerator with its original rational value, canonical bounded full-modulus residues, all required divisibilities, uniform eventual fixed-integer divisibility, finite numerical slot bounds and the numerical own-target array-letter identity. The actual earlier-variable exposure fixes every residue and slot shift, full own-target numerators and array residues; exact affine tail dependence of each progression and the whole own-target progression sum is proved. Concrete integer-input polynomial array groups, their common nilpotence bound, input translations, pointwise lattice coset evaluation and exact affine model linear orbits are constructed. The genuine original native Lie polynomial-array coefficient algebra, bracket closure, high-degree cutoff and finite dimension are now proved; literal Lie evaluation homomorphisms and their lower-central compatibility are constructed. The same-step lower-central cutoff of the genuine array Lie algebra, injectivity of all integer evaluations and simultaneous coefficient recovery by one fixed finite integer evaluation set are now proved, including for the original native model. The actual binary product native Lie algebra, componentwise original exponential and global logarithm, and integration and inherited topology of every product Lie subalgebra are now proved. The complete native array coefficient algebra now embeds by one fixed finite family of integer inputs into the native Lie algebra of an actual finite original-group product. Its finite evaluation image integrates to a closed contractible simply connected subgroup, uniquely parameterized by coefficient exponentials. All-integer multiplication compatibility, the exact full exponential array subgroup, its group isomorphism and inherited-topology homeomorphism with the finite image, contractibility, simply connectedness, and discreteness of its pointwise Gamma-valued subgroup for discrete Gamma are now proved. Cocompactness of the exact all-integer pointwise lattice is now proved by actual lattice monomial spanning, rational-log intersection, positive-root character descent and continuous quotient transfer. The actual integrated subalgebra and full native array group now have constructed smooth manifold and Lie group structures on their inherited topologies, and all literal integer evaluations are smooth. The actual array group and exact lattice instantiate the existing NativeNilmanifoldData interface at the same original nilpotency step, with constructed compatible quotient metric. Smooth quotient charts and quotient evaluation maps, integer input translations and their compatibility, and identification with the model-orbit array construction remain unproved. HasAlignmentMonomialRecurrence remains an explicit unproved input. Its genuine nilpotent recurrence proof, the actual native polynomial-array model action with its required nilpotence and translation compatibility, microcell boundary and point-law estimates, and positive-probability Alignment bounds remain unproved. Final ordered positive rapidly separated monochromatic extraction is incomplete. No unavoidable blocker is established. A complete public proof repository, official contribution PR, independent review and prize application remain pending; no completed prize submission is claimed.
